'''Subo''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who reigned over a sector of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Subo had an interest in the lost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endelaan]], believing the planet had a means with which he could extend his life indefinitely. To find the planet, he planted an agent on board the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Spiral Dancer]]'', which was trying to find Endelaan.<ref name=":The Unknown Regions" />
